trigger: Two days after Dead Air. Knock at the door. Only if ruiz_spared.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Ruiz, in a civilian parka. Her name tape is cut off. Rifle still slung.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: Kessler's shooting deserters now. Two this morning. I'm a deserter. Since about four a.m.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: I need somewhere to be that isn't there. I can wire, blast, and dig. I eat a lot.

choices.text: I can't. Not with Theo here.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: You shouldn't. I skipped houses with kids on the list. That's my whole résumé.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Theo looks at her rifle, then at you.

choices.text: I can't. Not with Theo here.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: ...Okay. Okay. Thanks. Don't— yeah. Where do I put my boots.

nodes.speaker: theo
nodes.text: you're the one who said 'clear'. at our house. i heard.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: Kid, I say 'clear' a lot. Sometimes it's even true.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: She walks toward the bridge, toward Wisconsin. She doesn't look back.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: That week, the sky goes brown at noon.
